inventory.module.name: Inventory
inventory.module.description: The theatre's props, costume, set and technical kit: what it owns, where each thing is, who has borrowed it, whether it is safe to use, and when it leaves for good. Nothing is ever lent twice over the same time.
Loan length offered when no end date is given
For a member or an outside borrower. They can choose a different end date, up to the longest loan.
inventory.settings.loans.max-length.help: No loan may run longer than this.
inventory.settings.loans.production-grac: Production kit is due back after the last performance by
Counted from the production's last performance. Moving the production's dates moves its loans with it.
inventory.settings.loans.remind-before.l: Remind the borrower before kit is due back
inventory.settings.loans.overdue-every.h: The borrower and the department are both told, until the kit comes back.
inventory.settings.loans.keep-for.label: Keep a borrower's details after a loan ends for
inventory.settings.loans.keep-for.help: Then their name, contact details and anything written about them are erased. The loan stays in each item's history.
inventory.settings.inspections.remind-be: The weekly inspections reminder looks ahead
Each department's inspectors are sent what falls due within this, and what is overdue.
inventory.settings.inspections.first-due: A new item's first inspection is due
Taking new kit as tested suits a theatre that buys new and tested.
On the day it is added
One interval after it is added
inventory.settings.faults.keep-for.label: Keep a closed fault's description and photos for
inventory.settings.faults.keep-for.help: Then they are erased. The item's history still shows that the fault happened and how it was closed.
inventory.settings.disposals.approve-abo: A disposal needs a second person's approval above
The item's replacement value. Nothing means every disposal needs a second person.
inventory.settings.catalogue.members-bro: Each kit department still chooses whether it lends to members.
inventory.settings.labels.size.label: Label size
inventory.settings.labels.size.help: The sheet of labels you print on.
inventory.settings.hired-in.remind-befor: Remind the department before hired-in kit goes back
For kit the theatre has hired or borrowed from someone else.
inventory.abilities.setup.manage.label: Set up kit departments, categories, stores and inspection kinds
inventory.navigation.departments.label: Departments
inventory.navigation.locations.label: Stores
inventory.setup.name: Name
inventory.departments.description: Each kit department keeps its own kit, makes its own tags and decides who may borrow. Give someone a role on one department to let them run it.
inventory.departments.prefix-help: Up to four capital letters. Every item's tag starts with it, such as CST-0042.
inventory.departments.prefix-changed: Items added from now on get the new prefix. Tags already on labels stay as they are.
inventory.departments.lends-to.label: Lends to
inventory.departments.contact-help: A role or a desk, such as the Wardrobe Manager, never a person's own name.
inventory.departments.guidance-help: Shown to anyone borrowing from this department, such as when the store is open.
inventory.departments.empty.title: No kit departments yet
inventory.departments.empty.description: Start from the usual four, or add your own.
inventory.departments.starting.title: The usual four
inventory.departments.starting.descripti: You can rename, change or archive any of them afterwards.
inventory.categories.none: No categories yet. Add one from this department's menu.
inventory.categories.kinds-help: A check added here falls due today for the items already in this category.
inventory.categories.no-kinds: There are no inspection kinds yet. Add them under Inspection kinds.
inventory.locations.description: Where kit is kept: stores, rooms, rails and shelves, up to four levels deep.
inventory.locations.inside-help: Moving a location moves everything inside it.
inventory.locations.venue-help: Locations inside this one are in the same venue unless they say otherwise.
inventory.locations.empty.title: No stores yet
inventory.locations.empty.description: Add the places kit is kept, such as a costume store, then the rails and shelves inside it.
inventory.kinds.description: The checks kit needs again and again, such as PAT testing. Each category says which of these its items need.
inventory.kinds.about-help: About the check, shown when recording it. Never about a person.
inventory.kinds.interval-help: The next check falls due this long after a pass.
inventory.kinds.interval-changed: Items already checked get a new due date, counted from their last pass.
inventory.kinds.certificate.label: Certificate
inventory.kinds.contractor: An outside firm may do it
inventory.kinds.contractor-help: The firm is named when the check is recorded.
inventory.kinds.blocks-help: An item overdue for this check cannot be lent or booked until it passes.
inventory.kinds.empty.title: No inspection kinds yet
inventory.kinds.empty.description: Start from the usual four, or add your own.
inventory.kinds.starting.title: The usual four
inventory.kinds.starting.description: Proposed intervals; change any of them afterwards.
inventory.navigation.items.label: Items
inventory.abilities.item.view.label: See a department's kit, its history, inspections and faults
inventory.abilities.item.edit.label: Add, change and move a department's kit
inventory.items.empty-help: Add your first item, or set up departments and categories first.
inventory.move.help: Anything inside a container goes with it. Moving it back to its home clears where it is now.
inventory.item.no-inspections: No inspections apply to this item
inventory.tracking-help.individual: Each has its own tag, inspections and history: a lantern, a costume, a drill.
inventory.tracking-help.counted: One tag for a quantity of things alike: cable ties, coat hangers, gel sheets.
inventory.item-form.category-help: Its inspections and training needs come from the category.
inventory.item-form.count-help: Each gets its own tag, numbered in turn.
inventory.item-form.lendable-help: Leave unticked for kit that stays in the building.
inventory.item-form.description-add: Its tag is given when you save.
inventory.labels.title: Labels
inventory.labels.help.one: {count} label. Print on sticker paper and stick it where it can be scanned.
inventory.labels.help.other: {count} labels. Print on sticker paper and stick each where it can be scanned.
inventory.labels.none: None of these items is yours to see
inventory.labels.print-these.one: Print a label for this item
